new_findings.title: Finalization manifest can hash reviewer files after their validated content has changed
new_findings.impact: The adopted decisions are derived from earlier validated maps, while the published provenance is derived by reopening paths later. A concurrent replacement can make a finalization manifest attest to invalid or different reviewer files that did not produce the result.
new_findings.required_fix: Read, parse, validate, hash, and retain immutable reviewer bytes once before building decisions; have publication consume only those retained bytes/metadata (or create validated copies in staging) and never reopen mutable reviewer input paths.

new_findings.title: bind-overlay artifact-name traversal escapes staging and leaves partial files
new_findings.impact: User-supplied names containing ../ are joined directly to the stage directory. A failed bind writes untracked artifacts outside both stage and target, defeating transactional publication and leaving collision-prone debris.
new_findings.reproduction: T-009 created escaped_queue.jsonl, escaped_template.jsonl, and escaped_manifest.json while no score-root bundle was published.
new_findings.required_fix: Before staging, require every artifact name to be a non-empty basename with no path separator, dot segment, drive, or absolute component; additionally require every writer destination to resolve beneath stage.

new_findings.title: A mixed-reviewer review3 input is accepted but recorded as one arbitrary reviewer
new_findings.impact: The finalization manifest's scalar reviewer_id is inaccurate for a multi-reviewer review3 file, impairing reviewer independence and provenance auditability.
new_findings.reproduction: T-010 accepted third-a and third-b in one review3 file and recorded only third-b.
new_findings.required_fix: Require exactly one reviewer_id per review3 input file, or publish a sorted complete reviewer_ids list and bind reviewer identity per adjudicated row.
